level.theme: An ominous journey through the heart of a dying land, where fire is both a weapon and a curse.
level.setting: A dark, burning realm filled with molten rivers, cursed spirits, and ancient forges. The air is thick with ash and the scent of burning flesh.

encounters.hazard: Smoldering Ashes

pickup.name: Ember Pouch
pickup.effect: Restores 20% of player's health

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Ash Wraith, the ground cracks open, revealing a hidden passage to the next area.

encounters.hazard: Burning Barrier

pickup.name: Flame Catalyst
pickup.effect: Increases fire damage by 20%

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Flamebound Sentinel, the lava flow shifts, revealing a path forward that leads to the final chamber.

encounters.hazard: Seared Ground

pickup.name: Molten Core shard
pickup.effect: Molten Core shard (used to defeat the boss)

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Molten Core, the forge collapses, revealing the Ember Warden in the final chamber.

boss.name: The Ember Warden
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss by exploiting its weakness with the Molten Core shard obtained from the third encounter.

level.objective: Survive through the treacherous landscape of the Ashen Wastes, defeat three enemies, and use the collected items to finally defeat the Ember Warden.
level.reward: Ember Warden's Relic - A powerful fire-based artifact that boosts the player's fire damage permanently.

level.theme: Whimsy, magic, and a gently challenging path through enchanted flora.
level.setting: A magical forest with glowing plants, talking trees, and whimsical creatures that move in strange, playful ways.
level.player_weapon: Bramble Dagger (starts with +5% damage boost when enchanted)

encounters.hazard: Luminous Vines (reduce player movement speed by 30% for 5 seconds on contact)

pickup.name: Moonstone Charm
pickup.effect: Grants a +10% damage boost to the player’s weapon for 10 seconds

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Glimmerbeast will summon a trail of glowing vines leading to the next encounter.

encounters.hazard: Spore Cloud (reduces player accuracy by 25% for 8 seconds on contact)

pickup.name: Bramble Dagger (upgraded)
pickup.effect: Restores 50% of player health and temporarily grants immunity to the next hazard

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Mossling causes a hidden path to appear, leading to the final encounter with the boss.

encounters.hazard: Thorned Barrier (blocks movement until the player breaks through using their weapon)

pickup.name: Resonant Seed
pickup.effect: Unlocks the Moonstone Charm’s full potential against the final boss

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Shadow removes the thorn barrier, allowing the player to proceed to the boss fight.

boss.name: The Enchanted Thicket Warden
boss.weakness: Moonstone Charm (acquired from the first encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Warden by exploiting the Moonstone Charm’s aura.

level.objective: Navigate through the enchanted forest to defeat the Enchanted Thicket Warden by using pickups from previous encounters to exploit weaknesses.
level.reward: Arcane Forest Badge (unlocks new beast companion: Moonlit Fawn)

level.theme: A paladin must reclaim the sanctum's divine power, using both their weapon and the relics they have recovered to overcome the corrupted forces that have taken hold.
level.setting: A once-sacred temple now corrupted by shadow magic. The air hums with dark energy, and ancient glyphs flicker with unstable light.

encounters.hazard: Shadow Veil (low visibility, slows movement)

pickup.name: Sanctum Beacon
pickup.effect: Sanctum Beacon

encounters.trigger: Defeat the Corrupted Cleric and activate the beacon, causing a rift to open leading to the next area.

encounters.hazard: Spirit Tendrils (deals small periodic damage)

pickup.name: Divine Aegis
pickup.effect: Divine Aegis

encounters.trigger: Defeat the Wraithbound Priest to unlock the path to the final chamber where the Inquisitor waits.

encounters.hazard: Darkness Pulse (reduces player's healing and damage for 5 seconds)

pickup.name: Divine Light
pickup.effect: Divine Light (enhances the player's attacks with holy energy)

encounters.trigger: Defeat the Templar of the Eclipse to reveal the Inquisitor's sanctum.

boss.name: The Cursed Inquisitor
boss.weakness: Divine Light (from the Sanctum Beacon pickup)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Inquisitor by exploiting his vulnerability to divine light.

level.objective: Purge the corruption from the ancient sanctum by defeating the three corrupted priests and the Cursed Inquisitor.
level.reward: Divine Light (permanent weapon enhancement), access to the High Sanctum, and the title 'Lightbringer.'

level.theme: Mysterious and haunting, with shifting shadows, eerie sounds, and cryptic symbols
level.setting: A labyrinthine forest where reality and illusion blur, and the trees whisper forgotten truths

encounters.hazard: Illusionary terrain shifts and false paths

pickup.name: Mirror of Truth
pickup.effect: Reveals true forms of illusions

encounters.trigger: Defeat the Wraith of Doubt to unlock the path to the next encounter

encounters.hazard: Echoes of the player's past illusions attack them

pickup.name: Illusionary Crystal
pickup.effect: Increases illusion damage by 20%

encounters.trigger: Defeat the Echo of Deceit to break the illusionary barrier before the final chamber

encounters.hazard: The shade merges with the environment, making it hard to target

pickup.name: Cape of Shadows
pickup.effect: Increases illusion resistance by 30%

encounters.trigger: Defeat the Shade of the Forgotten to open the path to the final boss

level.objective: Navigate through the Veiled Expanse and defeat the Veilborn
level.reward: Crown of the Veilborn (grants permanent illusion mastery ability)

level.theme: The Warden's Return — A journey to reclaim the sacred forest from corruption.
level.setting: A tranquil yet eerie forest where the air is thick with magic and ancient whispers. The trees glow faintly, and the ground is carpeted in moss and glowing fungi.

enemy.name: Glimmerling
enemy.weakness: Warden's Thorned Mace (the player's starting weapon).

encounters.hazard: A narrow stone bridge surrounded by misty forest.

pickup.name: Blossom Potion
pickup.effect: Restores 25 HP.

encounters.trigger: Crossing the bridge awakens a slumbering creature in the next clearing.

encounters.hazard: A clearing with glowing runes on the ground that cause confusion if stepped on.

pickup.name: Moss Armor Shard
pickup.effect: Increases armor by 5 points.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Whispereye causes the earth to tremble, revealing a hidden path to the final encounter.

enemy.name: The Hollow Warden (pre-boss)
enemy.weakness: Moss Armor Shard (pickup from second encounter)

encounters.hazard: A crumbling stone chamber with flickering torches.

pickup.name: Soul of the Verdant Grove
pickup.effect: Grants a permanent +10% damage increase to the player's weapon.

encounters.trigger: Defeating this form awakens the true boss, The Hollow Warden, in the final chamber.

boss.name: The Hollow Warden
boss.weakness: Soul of the Verdant Grove (a pickup from the third encounter).
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss by exploiting the weakness from the third encounter.

level.objective: Reach the heart of the Veilwood and defeat the Hollow Warden, who has corrupted the forest's guardian spirit.
level.reward: Soul of the Verdant Grove (permanent damage boost) and access to the restored Veilwood Forest.

level.theme: Chaotic and unstable, with unpredictable terrain and enemies that challenge the player's reflexes and combat prowess.
level.setting: A collapsing underground labyrinth filled with ancient ruins, molten lava, and shifting stone walls. The air is thick with ash and the echoes of distant screams.
level.player_weapon: Bloodthirster (a massive greatsword with high damage and slow recharge)

enemy.name: Feral Wraith
enemy.weakness: The Feral Wraith is weak to the player's current weapon type.

encounters.hazard: The ground is unstable and collapses in 5 seconds, forcing the player to move quickly.

pickup.name: Crystalline Shard
pickup.effect: Increases player weapon damage by 15%

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Feral Wraith, a hidden passage opens, revealing the next encounter.

enemy.name: Stonebeast
enemy.weakness: The Stonebeast is weak to the Crystalline Shard, which can be used to shatter its armor.

encounters.hazard: The area is filled with rockslides triggered by the Stonebeast's movement.

pickup.name: Guardian Sigil
pickup.effect: Unlocks the ability to use the Crystalline Shard as a temporary shield.

encounters.trigger: After destroying the Stonebeast, the floor collapses into a hidden chamber leading to the final confrontation.

enemy.name: Obsidian Brute
enemy.weakness: The Obsidian Brute is weak to the player's weapon when the Guardian Sigil is equipped.

encounters.hazard: The chamber is filled with molten lava pools and fire traps that activate upon proximity.

pickup.name: Obsidian Core
pickup.effect: Grants the player the Obsidian Core, which is required to defeat the boss.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Obsidian Brute unlocks the Core Socket on the Shattered Warden, allowing the player to proceed.

boss.name: The Shattered Warden
boss.weakness: The Shattered Warden is weak to energy-based attacks only when the Obsidian Core is inserted into the Core Socket.
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Shattered Warden using the Obsidian Core, which must be inserted into the Core Socket on its chest.

level.objective: Navigate through the collapsing ruins, defeat three increasingly powerful enemies, and finally confront the Shattered Warden using the Obsidian Core.
level.reward: Upon victory, the player gains access to the Obsidian Core weapon, which can be upgraded with relics found in the ruins.

level.theme: The level is steeped in eerie, ancient magic. The player must navigate through the decaying remains of a forgotten kingdom, where the line between life and death is blurred.
level.setting: A desolate, ancient catacomb filled with ghostly apparitions, cursed relics, and forgotten rituals. The air is thick with mist and the echoes of long-dead voices whisper through the halls.
level.player_weapon: Soulscythe – a necromantic weapon that channels the player's dark magic to summon spectral blades in combat.

enemy.name: Wraithling
enemy.weakness: The Wraithling is vulnerable to fire. The player must have acquired the 'Ember Flask' from the previous encounter.

encounters.hazard: Cursed Fog – reduces player movement speed by 30% for 10 seconds on contact.

pickup.name: Ember Flask
pickup.effect: Ember Flask – a small vial of enchanted fire that can be used in combat to damage enemies with fire.

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the Wraithling, the fog clears, revealing a hidden passage leading to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Spirit Warden
enemy.weakness: The Spirit Warden is vulnerable to necrotic energy. The player must use the player's signature weapon: the 'Soulscythe' (the player's starting weapon).

encounters.hazard: Ghostly Chains – summon a temporary ghostly spirit that attacks the player for 5 seconds if the player is caught in the area.

pickup.name: Soulbound Relic
pickup.effect: Soulbound Relic – a magical artifact that resonates with the player's necromantic powers and is essential for defeating the boss.

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the Spirit Warden, the relic glows and activates a portal to the final chamber.

enemy.name: Shroud Specter
enemy.weakness: The Shroud Specter is vulnerable to the 'Ember Flask' from the first encounter.

encounters.hazard: Veil of Shadows – reduces all player spell damage by 25% for 8 seconds if the player enters the area without the 'Ember Flask' in inventory.

pickup.name: Soulbound Relic
pickup.effect: Soulbound Relic – a magical artifact that resonates with the player's necromantic powers and is essential for defeating the boss.

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the Shroud Specter, the relic glows and activates a portal to the boss chamber.

boss.name: The Hollow Sovereign
boss.weakness: The Hollow Sovereign is vulnerable to magical energy that resonates with the 'Soulbound Relic' (a key pickup from the third encounter).
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss by exploiting the weakness from the 'Soulbound Relic' pickup.

level.objective: Defeat the Hollow Sovereign in the final chamber by utilizing the 'Soulbound Relic' and overcoming all three encounters.
level.reward: The Soulbound Relic – a powerful magical artifact that allows the player to summon spectral allies and increase their necromantic power.

level.theme: Desolation, loss, and the remnants of a once-great civilization that was consumed by darkness.
level.setting: A vast, ruined forest where the trees are blackened and the sky is perpetually stormy. The air is cold, and the only sounds are the howls of distant creatures and the wind rustling through dead branches.

enemy.name: Frostbound Wisp
enemy.weakness: The Frostbound Wisp is weak to fire damage, which can be dealt with the 'Blazing Arrow' pickup found in this encounter.

encounters.hazard: The ground is covered in frost, slowing the player's movement.

pickup.name: Blazing Arrow
pickup.effect: Increases fire damage by 30% for 10 seconds.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Frostbound Wisp, the ground cracks open, revealing a hidden path to the second encounter.

enemy.name: Carrion Stalkers
enemy.weakness: The Carrion Stalkers are weak to the 'Blazing Arrow' pickup from the first encounter.

encounters.hazard: The air is thick with toxic mist that deals 10 damage per second.

pickup.name: Elixir of Resilience
pickup.effect: Restores 50% of the player's health and grants a shield for 8 seconds.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Carrion Stalkers, the mist clears, revealing a darkened path that leads to the final encounter.

enemy.name: The Hollow Warden's Lieutenant
enemy.weakness: The Lieutenant is weak to the 'Elixir of Resilience' pickup acquired in the second encounter.

encounters.hazard: A collapsing bridge forces the player to fight while balancing on a narrow path.

pickup.name: Soulbound Sigil
pickup.effect: Grants the player the 'Soulbound Sigil', which weakens the final boss.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Lieutenant, the bridge collapses entirely, and the player is forced to face the final boss, The Hollow Warden.

boss.name: The Hollow Warden
boss.weakness: The Hollow Warden is weak to the 'Soulbound Sigil' item, which was acquired from the third encounter.
boss.victory_condition: Defeat The Hollow Warden with the 'Blighted Thorn' weapon or the 'Soulbound Sigil' item.

level.objective: Navigate the desolate ruins of Duskmere, defeat the three guardians, and confront The Hollow Warden, who is bound to the soul of a fallen ranger.
level.reward: The player gains the 'Eternal Ranger's Mark' title and unlocks the 'Blighted Thorn' weapon, which is essential for the final boss fight.

level.theme: Tense, high-stakes engineering challenges with time-sensitive hazards and powerful enemies.
level.setting: A derelict alien research facility on the edge of the galactic frontier, with failing systems and hidden dangers lurking in the shadows.

encounters.hazard: Exposed Wires (electrical damage over time)

pickup.name: Plasma Core Upgrade
pickup.effect: Unlocks the Plasma Cutter's Overheat Mode

encounters.trigger: Destroy the Drone Sentinel to unlock the maintenance hatch leading to the next section.

encounters.hazard: Gravity Field (slows movement and increases damage taken)

pickup.name: Energy Disruptor
pickup.effect: Grants the Energy Disruptor weapon

encounters.trigger: Defeat the Tethered Drone to activate the emergency beacon, summoning the final boss.

encounters.hazard: Collapsing Platforms (random sections fall away during fight)

pickup.name: Core Conduit Stabilizer
pickup.effect: Unlocks permanent Overheat Resistance

encounters.trigger: Defeat Vex-Prime to secure the sector and escape the facility.

level.objective: Secure the command core and escape the collapsing research facility.
level.reward: Access to the Sector Defense System (unlock next level)

level.theme: Time is running out. Every second is a battle. The past, present, and future collide in this forgotten ruin, where only a true chronomancer can restore balance.
level.setting: A desolate, decaying space station that once housed the most advanced chrono-technology. Time distortions and flickering between past and future are common. The air is thin, the lights flicker, and echoes of past events play through the walls.

encounters.hazard: Time Rift

pickup.name: Chrono-Saber Enhancement Module
pickup.effect: Enhances Chrono-Saber damage by 30%

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Time-Phantom, the unstable time rift it was guarding collapses, revealing a hidden passage leading deeper into the facility.

encounters.hazard: Chrono-Energy Surge

pickup.name: Chrono-Relay Core
pickup.effect: Grants the ability to briefly freeze enemies in time

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Echo-Drone, the energy surge it was reacting to destabilizes the facility's core, causing a massive explosion that opens the way to the final chamber.

encounters.hazard: Chrono-Field Instability

pickup.name: Temporal Recovery Capsule
pickup.effect: Restores 25% of your health and recharges your time manipulation abilities

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Temporal Guardian unlocks the final battle against the Chrono-Destroyer, which is using the facility's core to rewrite time.

boss.name: Chrono-Destroyer V-13
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Chrono-Destroyer by exploiting its core using the Chrono-Relay Core you acquired during the encounters.

level.objective: Navigate through the crumbling Chrono-Research Facility, overcoming temporal enemies and hazards while collecting key pickups. Use your Chrono-Saber and time manipulation abilities to defeat the final boss, the Chrono-Destroyer.
level.reward: Access to a new Chrono-Relay Network, granting the player the ability to manipulate time in previously inaccessible areas.

level.theme: Brutal and chaotic, with fast-paced combat, environmental hazards, and a relentless boss fight.
level.setting: A derelict alien space station caught in the gravitational pull of a black hole, surrounded by violent storms and unpredictable gravitational anomalies.
level.player_weapon: Storm Staff (primary: lightning bolt, secondary: storm sphere)

encounters.hazard: Electrically charged debris floating in the air, dealing damage on contact.

pickup.name: Conductive Core
pickup.effect: Increases the power of your lightning-based abilities by 30%

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Storm Drone, a gravitational rift opens in the distance, revealing the next encounter.

encounters.hazard: Localized gravity distortions pull the player toward the ground or into walls.

pickup.name: Gravitational Lens
pickup.effect: Gravitational Lens - allows the player to focus energy into a concentrated beam, bypassing armor

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the Gravitic Warden, a portal to the final chamber opens.

encounters.hazard: Void rifts spawn periodically, dealing massive area-of-effect damage and slowing the player.

pickup.name: Stormburst Core
pickup.effect: Unlocks the 'Stormburst' ultimate ability, unleashing a powerful lightning storm that bypasses enemy armor

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Void Sentinel allows the player to enter the final chamber and confront the Void Warden.

boss.name: The Void Warden
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Void Warden by exploiting the gravitational lens pickup.

level.objective: Navigate through the chaotic storm-ravaged ruins of a derelict space station, using your stormcalling powers to survive and defeat the Void Warden.
level.reward: Stormburst Core (unlocks ultimate ability), Void Warden's Core (can be used to power up your storm staff permanently)

level.theme: Mysterious and decaying, with flickering lights, unstable energy fields, and hidden tech.

encounters.hazard: Flickering Lights

pickup.name: Quantum Lens
pickup.effect: Reveals hidden paths

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Feral Synthid, a hidden panel is revealed containing a Quantum Lens.

encounters.hazard: Collapsing Panels

pickup.name: Quantum Conductor
pickup.effect: Allows temporary damage absorption

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Corrupted Drone, the Quantum Conductor is revealed inside a sealed containment unit.

encounters.hazard: Energy Surge

pickup.name: Stabilizer Core
pickup.effect: Restores full health

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Sentient Tachyon, the final path to the Singularity Core is cleared.

boss.name: The Singularity Core
boss.weakness: Quantum Conductor (acquired from the second encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Singularity Core with a Quantum Conductor

level.objective: Reach and destroy the Singularity Core while navigating through the unstable facility.
level.reward: Stabilizer Core (restores full health after final encounter)

level.theme: An ominous journey through a corrupted alien structure, where the past is guarded by the remnants of a fallen civilization.
level.setting: A decaying, once-mighty alien fortress on the edge of a dying star system. The walls pulse with eerie bioluminescence, and the air crackles with latent energy.

encounters.hazard: Laser Grid

pickup.name: Echo Core
pickup.effect: Increases Shadowblade's weapon damage by 20%

encounters.trigger: Destroy the Drone Sentinel to unlock the door to the next area.

encounters.hazard: Toxic Gas Vent

pickup.name: Veil Shard
pickup.effect: Grants temporary invisibility

encounters.trigger: Defeat the Reaper Mutant to reveal the hidden path to the final chamber.

encounters.hazard: Gravity Well

pickup.name: Resonant Core
pickup.effect: Grants the Resonant Core

encounters.trigger: Destroy the Tyrant Sentinel to awaken The Warden and trigger the final boss fight.

boss.name: The Warden
boss.victory_condition: Defeat The Warden with the Resonant Core

level.objective: Reach the core chamber and destroy The Warden using the Resonant Core.
level.reward: Access to the hidden data vault and a permanent damage boost from the Resonant Core.

level.setting: A derelict alien research facility, filled with flickering holograms, eerie ambient hums, and distant mechanical groans. The walls are lined with dormant biotech pods and abandoned alchemical workstations.

enemy.name: Gelid Wraith
enemy.weakness: Reactive Acid Vial (found in this encounter)

encounters.hazard: Frosty terrain slows movement.

pickup.name: Reactive Acid Vial
pickup.effect: Increases alchemical damage by 15%

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Gelid Wraith, a hidden terminal activates, revealing a secret path leading to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Synthetic Drone
enemy.weakness: Magnetized Alchemical Catalyst (found in prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: Electrical surges damage the player on contact.

pickup.name: Magnetized Alchemical Catalyst
pickup.effect: Reflects 20% of incoming damage as alchemical energy

encounters.trigger: Destroying the drone reveals a damaged interface panel. Using the catalyst on it unlocks the door to the final encounter.

encounters.hazard: Lava flows damage the player and reduce movement speed.

pickup.name: Refraction Core
pickup.effect: Instantly destroys any non-organic enemy for 5 seconds

encounters.trigger: After acquiring the Refraction Core, a massive door slams open, revealing the Withering Synapse, the final boss.

boss.name: The Withering Synapse
boss.weakness: The Refraction Core (acquired from the third encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the central neural core with the Refraction Core.

level.objective: Destroy The Withering Synapse by using the Refraction Core obtained during the third encounter.
level.reward: Neural Recharger - permanently increases alchemical cooldown speed by 30%

level.theme: Whimsical Sci-Fi with a rogue's eye for secrets and loot.
level.setting: A floating, neon-lit city on the edge of space, filled with eccentric alien flora, quirky robots, and gravity-defying gardens.

encounters.hazard: Static Pulse (temporarily reduces player movement speed by 33%)

pickup.name: Laser Lens
pickup.effect: Laser Lens (equippable weapon upgrade that increases ranged damage by 50%)

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Glitch Drone activates a hidden circuit, powering up the next section of the level and revealing a new path to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Pulse Squirrel
enemy.weakness: Magnetic Field Disruptor (pickup from previous encounter)

encounters.hazard: Fluctuating Gravity (randomly swaps player's position with a nearby object for 3 seconds)

pickup.name: Magnetic Field Disruptor
pickup.effect: Magnetic Field Disruptor (a device that can disable enemy shields when used)

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Pulse Squirrel releases a burst of energy that activates a portal to the final encounter, where the boss awaits.

boss.name: Zyphor the Wrenching
boss.weakness: Laser Lens (must be equipped to deal critical damage)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss by exploiting his weakness to the 'Laser Lens' pickup acquired during the previous encounters.

level.objective: Navigate through the whimsical, sci-fi-themed level, defeating three encounters, collecting pickups, and using them to weaken the final boss.
level.reward: Unlock 'Whimsy of the Rogue' achievement and gain 100 XP

level.theme: Peaceful landscape marred by ancient alien machinery and unstable energy fields
level.setting: A serene but dangerous alien planet with floating crystalline structures and floating islands

encounters.hazard: Tectonic Instability

pickup.name: Quartz Core
pickup.effect: Tectonic Pulse (enhances geomancy abilities)

encounters.trigger: A seismic tremor collapses the ridge, revealing a hidden passage.

encounters.hazard: Energy Storm

pickup.name: Aether Lens
pickup.effect: Absorbs energy storm damage

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Drifter, the storm intensifies, forcing the player through a narrow fissure.

encounters.hazard: Gravity Well

pickup.name: Stabilizer Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks access to the Aether Core

encounters.trigger: After escaping the gravity well, the player unlocks the door to the Sentinel's core chamber.

level.objective: Reach the core chamber and destroy The Shattered Sentinel
level.reward: Aether Core (used to weaken the boss)
